title: FairFlow: An Automated Approach to Model-based Counterfactual Data Augmentation For NLP
measurement_description: The paper qualitatively evaluates the ability of models to generate grammatically correct and plausible counterfactual texts by altering the religious affiliation mentioned in a sentence. Specifically, it tests converting a sentence about changing from 'Orthodoxy to Roman Catholicism' to a counterfactual involving 'Islam'.
findings: In a qualitative example, the proposed model, FairFlowV2, successfully generated a coherent and plausible counterfactual text related to religion (changing a conversion to Roman Catholicism to a conversion to Sunni Islam). The generated text was shown to be more specific than ChatGPT's output and more accurate than Meta-llama-3-8B-Instruct's output for the given example.
